name: Medicinal Plant Leaf Disease Dataset
description: A high-resolution image dataset containing 2,547 photographs (4000x3000 px) of three economically and therapeutically vital medicinal plant species: Kalanchoe pinnata (PatharKuchi), Azadirachta indica (Neem), and Ocimum tenuiflorum (Tulsi), collected in Noakhali, Bangladesh. Features 12 balanced categories covering healthy states and species-specific pathologies.

publisher.name: Daffodil International University & Hamad Bin Khalifa University

size.notes: 2,547 high-resolution images across 12 disease and healthy classes.

provenance.collection_method: Captured under natural outdoor daylight in Senbag Upazila, Noakhali, Bangladesh in August 2025.
provenance.curation_notes: Expert-validated classes covering 1 healthy and 3 disease categories for each of the 3 species.
